factors.name: Core on-page SEO present (title, meta description, H1, mobile viewport)
factors.note: Direct curl of the homepage raw HTML confirms a descriptive title tag ('Dent Ops | Veteran Owned Paintless Dent Repair'), a descriptive meta description, a real H1 ('No Dents Left Behind'), and a correct mobile viewport meta tag. All four core elements present.

factors.name: Structured data / schema (LocalBusiness or equivalent) present
factors.note: No application/ld+json block or any other schema.org markup appears anywhere in the homepage source, confirmed by direct grep of the fetched HTML.

factors.name: Content depth, dedicated service page(s), location page, any FAQ content
factors.note: The site is a single page. Every attempted subpage (/about, /services, /faq, /contact, /process, /reviews, /gallery, /blog, /anna-tx, /hail-repair, /paintless-dent-repair) returned HTTP 404 when checked directly. Service descriptions exist only as short anchor sections on the homepage; there is no FAQ content and no dedicated location page, even though the business states it serves the whole DFW metroplex.

factors.name: Technical health, HTTPS, no broken core links, crawlable (sane robots.txt/sitemap)
factors.note: HTTPS works correctly and plain http:// redirects to https:// with a 301. robots.txt is sane and allows full crawling. However, sitemap.xml returns a 404. The www subdomain (www.dent-ops.com) fails completely with a Cloudflare 522 connection-timeout error on every attempt. The top navigation also shows 'About' and 'Process' styled identically to real menu links but they are inert, non-clickable elements with no destination page.

factors.name: GBP found and reasonably complete
factors.note: A Google Business Profile was found and directly fetched twice (business.google.com mirror page), showing full hours (Mon-Fri 8am-7pm, Sat 10am-3pm, closed Sun), category (paintless dent repair and hail damage restoration), and phone. The public listing shows only 'Anna, TX 75409' with no street number, which is typical for a mobile/service-area business rather than a flaw, but it means a street-level address cannot be confirmed from the GBP itself. Labeled Likely rather than Verified because the live Google Maps UI itself was not browsed directly, only a business.google.com mirror page.

factors.name: NAP consistency across listings found
factors.note: Phone (469) 325-6117 matches exactly between the Google Business Profile and the independently owned website. The GBP shows only 'Anna, TX 75409' while the website separately publishes a full street address (1924 Graybill Rd). This is not a contradiction, but it is an incomplete cross-match since the two sources do not state the identical address string, so partial rather than full credit.

factors.name: Appears in results for the primary local query tested
factors.note: Dent Ops's Google Business Profile surfaced as the top business result for both primary test queries, 'paintless dent repair Anna TX' and 'hail damage repair Anna TX', run today. Labeled Likely rather than Verified per methodology, since live Maps rank position itself was not checked in the Maps UI.

factors.name: Review volume relative to the competitor set identified in this audit
factors.note: Dent Ops has 13 confirmed Google reviews. Competitor review counts for Top Notch Image, VIVID Auto Body Shop, and AMP Hail could not be independently confirmed this session (the web search budget for this session was exhausted mid-audit, and direct fetches of their review pages were blocked or truncated). Scored as a cautious partial credit rather than a confident comparison, since these are longer-established, multi-service shops that would plausibly carry a larger review base than a single specialty operator, but this is not confirmed with hard numbers.

factors.name: Rating
factors.note: 5.0 out of 5 stars, confirmed identically on two independent direct fetches of the Google Business Profile.

factors.name: Recency (at least one review in roughly the last 6 months)
factors.note: The most recent visible review (Pamela Rigopoulos) is dated 2 months prior to the audit date, well within the 6-month window.

factors.name: Owner responses present on any reviews
factors.note: Neither of the two full review excerpts visible on the fetched Google Business Profile shows an owner response. The remaining 11 of 13 reviews were not individually visible in the fetched mirror page, so this is Likely rather than fully confirmed, but no owner response was observed anywhere.

factors.name: Business identity stated clearly and consistently somewhere crawlable
factors.note: Name, phone, services (paintless dent repair, hail damage restoration, door dings/creases), service area (Anna, TX plus the full DFW metroplex), and veteran-owned positioning are all stated clearly in the live homepage text, confirmed by direct fetch.

factors.name: Structured data / consistent NAP an AI system could read
factors.note: No schema markup exists on the website (confirmed, see website_seo). Phone is consistent across the two sources checked, but address is only partially cross-verifiable between the website and the GBP (see local_google NAP note), so an AI system crawling both would see partial, not fully structured, agreement.

factors.name: Content directly answering likely customer questions
factors.note: The homepage briefly covers insurance handling, zero deductible on qualified estimates, and free rental car assistance in a few sentences, but there is no FAQ page and every attempted FAQ/service subpage returns a 404. Little else answers common questions like typical turnaround time or how mobile service scheduling works.

factors.name: No contradictory facts across sources checked
factors.note: Phone is identical everywhere checked. No outright contradictions were found, though the address gap (the website publishes a full street address the GBP does not show) is a completeness gap rather than a clean match, so this falls short of full marks.

technical_findings.finding: Dent Ops has an independently owned, live website at dent-ops.com (not just a Google Business Profile), built as a single-page site with a custom modern framework (SvelteKit).

technical_findings.finding: No structured data (schema.org/LocalBusiness or any JSON-LD) exists anywhere on the homepage.
technical_findings.evidence: grep for 'application/ld+json' and 'schema.org' against the full fetched HTML source returned zero matches.

technical_findings.finding: Every subpage attempted returns a 404; the entire site is one page with anchor links.
technical_findings.evidence: Direct HTTP status checks on /about, /services, /faq, /contact, /process, /reviews, /gallery, /blog, /anna-tx, /hail-repair, and /paintless-dent-repair all returned 404. methodology_notes: This record supersedes an earlier draft of research/dent-ops.json that incorrectly concluded no independently owned website existed; a direct, repeated curl fetch of https://dent-ops.com/ in this session confirms a real, independently owned site matching the business's exact phone number and address, so the website_seo category is scored on its actual content rather than zeroed out. No Google Search Console, GBP Insights, or live Google Maps UI access exists in this environment; all GBP-related findings come from a business.google.com mirror page fetched directly twice with consistent results (5.0 stars, 13 reviews), not from browsing Maps itself, so those findings are labeled Likely rather than Verified per the schema's rule for this category. Yelp and Facebook listings for Dent Ops were located by search but could not be opened directly (Yelp returned HTTP 403; Facebook returned an empty page shell to the fetch tool), so their internal details (review counts, exact categories) are not independently confirmed here and are not used as scored evidence beyond the address cross-check. This session's web search budget was exhausted partway through competitor research (a shared, session-wide limit across several parallel audits running at the same time), which prevented confirming exact review counts for the three competitors identified; this is why the review-volume comparison factor is marked Hypothesis rather than Verified or Likely. Two competitor domains (allenhailrepair.com and amphail.com) were found referenced in search results but could not be reached directly this session: allenhailrepair.com returned a hosting-suspension error page, and amphail.com timed out on repeated direct connection attempts; neither was used as a primary competitor beyond AMP Hail, which is included with that caveat stated explicitly. No screenshots were captured for this record; capture before this record is relied on for a printed brief, especially a screenshot of the www.dent-ops.com error page and the Christmas popup, since both are strong visual evidence.
